title: ScriptureRecord
description: A canonicalised reference to a Bible passage, including its text, translation metadata, optional on-chain attestation details, financial theme keywords matched by the scripture_search agent, references to original-language source texts, and links to cross-language and theological validation records.

record_id.description: Globally unique identifier for this scripture record.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the ScriptureRecord schema (e.g. '1.0.0').

verses.description: Verse or verse range being referenced.

full_name.description: Full name of the translation (e.g. 'King James Version').

year_published.description: Year the translation was first published.

text.description: Verbatim scripture text for the specified reference.

topics.description: Theological or topical tags associated with this passage (e.g. 'faith', 'stewardship', 'prosperity').

financial_keywords.description: Financial theme keywords matched by the scripture_search agent during KJV traversal (e.g. 'debt', 'money', 'wealth', 'tithe', 'mammon', 'treasure', 'usury', 'silver', 'gold'). Populated by the agentic pipeline; empty array indicates no financial keywords were matched.

original_language_refs.description: References to this passage in its original Biblical languages (Hebrew, Greek, or Aramaic), captured by the language_validator subagent.

language.description: The original language of this reference.

source_text.description: The passage text in its original script (e.g. Hebrew Unicode, Greek Unicode).

transliteration.description: Optional romanised transliteration of the original-language text.

source_corpus.description: Name of the source corpus used (e.g. 'Westminster Leningrad Codex', 'NA28', 'Peshitta').

cross_language_validation_id.description: UUID of the CrossLanguageValidation record produced by the language_validator agent for this scripture. Present only after the language validation stage of the agentic pipeline has completed.

theological_validation_id.description: UUID of the TheologicalValidation record produced by the theological_validator agent for this scripture. Present only after the theological validation stage of the agentic pipeline has completed.

attestation.description: Optional on-chain attestation linking this record to a smart contract or NFT.

chain_id.description: EVM chain ID where the attestation lives (e.g. 1 for Ethereum mainnet).

contract_address.description: Address of the attestation smart contract.

token_id.description: Token ID (as a string to handle uint256) of the attestation NFT.

tx_hash.description: Transaction hash of the mint or registration event.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this record was created.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this record was last updated.
